summary: Selects a single option among mutually exclusive, fully visible alternatives, with per-option descriptions and group validation.
whenToUse: 2 to ~6 exclusive alternatives to compare at a glance.
When options have different descriptions or costs.
whenNotToUse: Many options: use Select or Combobox.
On/off choice: use Switch or Checkbox.
Switching views: use Tabs or ToggleGroup.
inherits: react-aria-components RadioGroup and RadioField props (name, form…).

keyboard.action: Enters the group on the selected option (or the first one).
Move focus and select the next/previous option (RTL-aware).

accessibility: Native radio inputs with roving tabindex.
An individual option's description is added to the group's in the announcement.
Selection is indicated by an inner dot, not only by color.
responsive: The horizontal layout wraps; prefer vertical with long text.
commonMistakes: Using onChange to perform actions (the choice must be reversible before submission).
Leaving the group without an initial value when a sensible default exists.
